scope: Handwritten production firmware/components and firmware/main C/header/inc files; tests excluded.

exceptions.detail: PSRAM-stack translation unit: read_bounced calls esp_partition_read
exceptions.reason: Read only. This TU requires CONFIG_SPIRAM_XIP_FROM_PSRAM at compile time. ESP-IDF components/spi_flash/spi_flash_os_func_app.c spi1_start uses only the SPI1 mutex for reads when !MMAP_EXECUTABLES_FROM_FLASH, keeping the cache enabled. No write/erase API is exempt.

exceptions.detail: PSRAM-stack translation unit: orb_fonts_port_map calls esp_partition_mmap
exceptions.reason: Internal caller only. Raw font mapping is reached by synchronous font loading on the internal UI stack or the deferred main service preload; the PSRAM font task was removed. ESP-IDF flash_mmap.c uses esp_mmu_map when CONFIG_SPI_FLASH_ROM_IMPL=n, and esp_mmu_map.c s_stop_cache reaches esp_cache_freeze_caches_disable_interrupts, whose DRAM-stack assertion forbids PSRAM callers. orb_fonts_port_map has a debug-only internal-stack assertion. The PSRAM boot verifier never invokes this helper. No write/erase API is exempt.

exceptions.detail: PSRAM-stack translation unit: copy_bitmaps calls esp_partition_munmap
exceptions.reason: Internal caller only. copy_bitmaps is called by orb_assets_update_begin from the internal OTA installer before assets erase/write, with a debug-only internal-stack assertion. ESP-IDF esp_mmu_unmap freezes caches and requires a DRAM stack; PSRAM XIP does not make unmapping safe. Neither the PSRAM boot verifier nor the audio reader invokes this helper. No write/erase API is exempt.

exceptions.detail: PSRAM-stack translation unit: orb_fonts_port_unmap calls esp_partition_munmap
exceptions.reason: Internal caller only. Font release runs on the internal UI stack or deferred main service preload; the PSRAM font task was removed. ESP-IDF esp_mmu_unmap freezes caches and requires a DRAM stack; PSRAM XIP does not make unmapping safe. orb_fonts_port_unmap has a debug-only internal-stack assertion. The PSRAM boot verifier never invokes this helper. No write/erase API is exempt.
